Recent work: community-based delivery including the Bigstone retreat, grant-writing cohorts for grassroots organizations, curriculum built for Win Together Canada Foundation, and team dynamics training for the YMCA.

We have built curriculum for Win Together Canada Foundation, delivered team dynamics training for the YMCA, supported funded programs with Employabilities, and led grant-writing and board strategic planning workshops for grassroots organizations. Where a community prefers on-territory delivery, we travel and train locally so the capacity stays in the community.
